text: To identify Zirconium by atomic number, use 40.
To identify Niobium by atomic number, use 41.
To identify Molybdenum by atomic number, use 42.
For Gabon, the city to name as its capital is Libreville.
For The Gambia, the city to name as its capital is Banjul.
For Guinea, the city to name as its capital is Conakry.
When writing Zirconium in chemical notation, use Zr.
When writing Niobium in chemical notation, use Nb.
When writing Molybdenum in chemical notation, use Mo.
To place Gabon by continent, use Africa.
To place The Gambia by continent, use Africa.
To place Guinea by continent, use Africa.
For transactions in Gabon, the currency to use is the Central African CFA franc.
For transactions in The Gambia, the currency to use is the dalasi.
For transactions in Guinea, the currency to use is the Guinean franc.
To place Zirconium on the periodic table, use period 5.
To place Niobium on the periodic table, use period 5.
To place Molybdenum on the periodic table, use period 5.
